fluff.overview: Drawing veterans from the Com Guards, recruits from the Free Worlds League, and volunteers from Protectorate worlds, the Word of Blake Militia assembled infantry formations whose quality varied but whose equipment was consistently first-rate. Foot infantry Level I formations provided the bulk of Protectorate garrison manpower, assigned to hold ground that the Militia's BattleMech forces had already taken. On occupied worlds, these platoons maintained checkpoints, patrolled population centers, and enforced curfews as the visible face of Blakist territorial control. Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these troops field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
